project.title: Analytics Platform on AWS

parentsummary.deliverables: Built a cloud-native analytics platform on AWS using AWS Glue, AWS Database Migration Service (DMS), AWS Lambda, and AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK) v2, backed by an automated CI/CD and DevSecOps security-scanning pipeline.
parentsummary.outcomes: Departmental data analysis workloads gained a cloud-native AWS analytics platform with continuous delivery, an auditable deployment history, and automated code and IaC security scanning.

challenge.summary: The Analytics team at Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) needed cloud-native applications on AWS to support departmental data analysis. Under a part-time architecture engagement, releases had to meet Government of Canada (GoC) security requirements, with both application code and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) scanned.

deliverables: Built the cloud-native analytics application stack on AWS using AWS Glue, AWS DMS, and AWS Lambda
Authored the platform's IaC in AWS CDK and migrated the CDK infrastructure code from v1 to v2
Engineered automated CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodeCommit, AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, and AWS CodeDeploy
Integrated automated code and IaC security scanning into a DevSecOps deployment pipeline
Produced security and governance reporting on application code and IaC
Improved deployment practices and release management procedures over the course of the engagement

outcomes: Cloud-native AWS analytics platform delivered for departmental data analysis workloads, built with AWS Glue, AWS DMS, AWS Lambda, and AWS CDK v2
Fully automated CI/CD pipelines gave the Analytics team continuous delivery and an auditable deployment history
Application code and IaC security scanning automated by the deployment pipeline, alongside security and governance reporting produced by Christian on both
